key_safety.text: Most common adverse drug reactions (≥3% and greater than placebo) were headache (15% vs 13%), nausea (9% vs 7%), sinus congestion (4% vs 2%), and dizziness (4% vs 2%). Most serious AEs were pulmonary exacerbations of CF (~7% TEZ/IVA vs 10% placebo). Transaminase elevations noted with SYMDEKO or ivacaftor.
